what: Every audio recording imported by Scripts/release_soundscape_v2.py. One entry per shipped file. The credits screen reads this folder at run time (UMikdashFrontEnd::ReadThirdPartyCredits), takes the assets array, and prints name + author + license for each row, so every row here becomes a visible credit.
licenceRule: A file appears in assets only if its licence was verified against the captured publisher page under SourceAssets/soundscape-review/SoundscapeV2/evidence/. evidenceQuote is the exact substring the verdict rests on. Anything that could not be verified goes to notShipped and is never imported.
attributionNote: Exactly one file in this set carries a licence that LEGALLY REQUIRES a credit in a shipped build: ClothSwing_Vinrax.wav, CC BY 3.0, Vinrax. Everything else is CC0 or an explicit author public-domain dedication and requires none. All are credited anyway.
publicDomainCaveat: The seven Wikimedia entries marked 'public domain' rest on that site's author-release template, which is a dedication by a named author and NOT a Creative Commons instrument. No deed URL is claimed for them; the assertion rests on the captured file page. Snapshots were taken 2026-09-07/08 and no network call was made to re-confirm them since.
notHeard: Licence and container only. Nobody has listened to any of these recordings end to end. A file with a clean licence can still contain a voice, a vehicle or a handling bump, and no check in this project can see those.
